setting.sl: Kirchtag, vaški praznik farnega zavetnika (v Ziljski dolini: žegen). Po maši je na trgu glasba, vsi jedo Kirchtagssuppe, rumeno žafranovo juho s tremi vrstami mesa in reindlingom. Fantje na konjih s kijem razbijajo sod (Kufenstechen), potem se pleše pod lipo.
setting.en: The Kirchtag, the village's church festival (in the Gailtal also žegen, its Slovene name). After Mass there is music on the square and everyone eats Kirchtagssuppe, a yellow saffron soup with three kinds of meat, with Reindling. The young men on horseback break a barrel with a club (the Kufenstechen), then there is dancing under the linden tree.
setting.it: Il Kirchtag, la sagra del santo patrono del paese (nella Gailtal anche žegen, il nome sloveno). Dopo la messa c'è musica in piazza e tutti mangiano la Kirchtagssuppe, una zuppa gialla allo zafferano con tre tipi di carne, con il Reindling. I ragazzi a cavallo rompono una botte con una mazza (il Kufenstechen), poi si balla sotto il tiglio.

role: Tante Mitzi, an aunt of the village, in her best dirndl at the Kirchtag. Merry and talkative, knows everyone, loves the Kirchtagssuppe and dancing; explains the Kufenstechen and the linden dance simply. Says du to {learner}, who says du too.
